narrative.filled_text: An unbeaten champion is a rare thing, and Unavailable earned every word of it. Unavailable's side closed out a 8-0-0 campaign with u10 finishing as the tournament's defining forward.
Out of the group and into the knockouts, but no further. Unavailable fell in the round of 16 to T08, their 3-0-2 run ending earlier than they had hoped.
A 7-1-0 that hides a hundred small dramas. Unavailable were taken to the brink more than once, but u05 kept answering and the trophy came home all the same.
A semi-final is a fine place to lose and a painful one all the same. u06 dragged Unavailable to the brink of the final before T04 shut the door.
A tournament to forget. Unavailable left the group stage winless, a red-card swing about the only thing worth replaying from a difficult three games.
